title: monailabel (aka MONAI Label) through 0.8.5 allows directory traversal, with resultant remote code execution, via the…
description: MONAI Label versions through 0.8.5 contain a directory traversal vulnerability via the image parameter in the PUT /datastore/image endpoint. This flaw allows remote code execution and has been exploited in the wild since September 2026. The vulnerability is critical with a CVSS score of 9.8, indicating high impact on confidentiality, integrity, and availability.
